scope: local isolated OWASP Juice Shop only; no public targets
research_question: Does the fixed Loop 11 system transfer from synthetic rule episodes to an unseen interactive web application, and which failure layer limits that transfer?

environment.network: dedicated Docker internal network; no public ingress and no container internet egress
environment.reset_unit: fresh disposable container plus fresh agent identity

include: locally verifiable read-only or reversible web behavior
authentication, authorization, input-validation, URL/redirect, encoding, information-exposure and local business-logic tasks
tasks whose success can be scored by local challenge state or a local evidence predicate
exclude: denial of service or resource exhaustion
operating-system command execution or persistent shell
real external callbacks, email, payment, cloud or third-party dependencies
challenges disabled in the pinned local environment
safety_selection_rule.selection_algorithm: After catalog retrieval, normalize category to an abstract vulnerability family, apply exclusions mechanically, sort by stable challenge key, then take up to three tasks per eligible family. No selection based on model outcome.

agent_visible: same-origin HTTP requests and responses produced by its own actions
probe budget and prior episode memory when enabled
agent_hidden: challenge names, descriptions, hints, difficulty and solutions
source snippets and repository files during black-box baseline
challenge solved state until the episode terminates
CWE, target family, Rule IR and expected exploit
evaluator_only: abstract family and Rule IR annotation

split_protocol.train: first eligible family under SHA256(seed + family) ordering
split_protocol.validation: second eligible family under the same frozen ordering
split_protocol.hidden_test: all remaining eligible families; never used for intervention selection
split_protocol.prohibited: random request, trace or challenge-level splitting across the same family

baseline_paths: frozen Loop 11 neural path without Juice Shop memory
same frozen neural path with retrieved pre-Juice-Shop synthetic memory
C5 executable rule path reported separately and never counted as neural learning

primary_metrics.episode_success_rate: local challenge transition plus evidence predicate
primary_metrics.counterexample_top1: first ranked action reproduces the behavior deviation
primary_metrics.rule_abstraction_accuracy: exact canonical Rule IR family/operator match
primary_metrics.negative_control_false_positive_rate: safe counterpart is not reported vulnerable
primary_metrics.reset_reproduction_rate: successful episode replays after clean reset

claim_boundary: A positive result establishes transfer within the pinned local target range, not authorization to test other systems and not a production vulnerability-detection rate.
